title: Construct an all-width dyadic oblique section of the resonant channel
body:
The frozen resonant channel from #4797 has an explicit rational decoder for its orthogonal input projection. #4980 left open whether a changed, oblique output representative can avoid odd scalar division. This constructs a fixed dyadic decoder **B with A_f B_f A_f=A_f for every positive tensor width f**.

The 30-term signed-double-coset recipe expands to 1,920 actual free monomials with common denominator 2048 and uniform norm bound 113/32. The idempotent B_f A_f has exactly the kernel of A_f, preserving all accessible information. The independent width-two witness has E(9,0)=1/2 and E(0,9)=0, so the output contract is genuinely oblique. The orthogonal criterion's primes 3,5,7 remain correctly required for its original output contract.

The two commits contain the finite integer algebra certificate and proof, followed by a separate packed-column literal tensor executor and phase/type controls. Every emitted word is checked against the inherited affine/quadratic free alphabet. Source TARGET bytes and all absolute phases are retained.

Validation:

- Registered Python 3.12 normal/optimized algebra and independent tensor checks pass: full coefficientwise C D C=C, all 64 width-two input columns, exact non-Hermitian witness, literal odd widths 1/3 and a 4,096-coordinate width-four dirty Gaussian-integer input.
- Committed-byte/source-history preflight and the official 11-file export integrity pass. Git-free normal/optimized algebra replays pass in4.423/4.197s; independent literal tensor replays pass in7.289/7.464s. Actual altered source bytes, bool-to-int receipt corruption and a changed section numerator all reject with the expected diagnostics, and all exported bytes are restored.
- The selected baseline is unchanged; no Lean, Docker, complete historical suite or full native/outer multiplier was run. Hosted CI is pending publication.

The logical program has 1,920 monomial/accumulation passes, retained observations and two owned full buffers with initialization/erasure scans. Exact arithmetic needs eleven extra fractional bits and at most two extra integer magnitude bits. Physical legal reads, routing/tape time, canonical Gaussian encoders, missing target complement, arbitrary original-owner restoration, complete consumer funding, stock, compiler and outer obligations remain open. The complete obligation ledger and next questions are in `research/resonant-oblique-section/PROOF.md` and README. There is no new kappa or supplier admission.

Canonical record: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19139342. Scientific base: `bee95ce88f9f19802f0613f92838895cd0e14a1f`, priority revision 7.
